scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic for all dimensions n at least 2 and all reciprocal exponents strictly between zero and one. It uses the exact Dirichlet moment formula, Gauss's multiplication identity for trigamma, and a strict coordinatewise grid comparison. Numerical quadrature is only a replayable sanity check and is not used to infer the continuum statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the canonical real ell_p ball family and proves strict log-concavity in reciprocal exponent, not in the exponent itself and not along arbitrary convex-body paths. Endpoint values are obtained by continuity.
title: Strict log-concavity of Ball's Santaló moment product along the ℓp scale
